subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: How I am the same as my friends and how I am different (height, hair colour, gender, weight)

show.line: We are all special! Some are tall, some are short. We can do many things!

rounds.prompt: Tell me something you can do!

rounds.story: Lwazi is short and Pieter is tall. Both love soccer. Are they the same or different?
rounds.praise: Both! Different heights, same favourite game.
Different is good! Everyone is special.

rounds.prompt: Say it proudly. I am special!

hints: Look closely at hair, height and faces.
Being different makes each of us special.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I think we must all look the same.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Everyone must have the same hair!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is good to be different.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: We are all different and all special!

parent_line: Can say how they are the same as and different from friends, with self-respect.
